The '''S-400 Stealth Saboteur''' was a type of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
